mission: Aftermath — Veraine contained, not killed. Her ideology intact but her thesis empirically disproven. She'll spend years rationalizing the failure. She is the book's living counterargument, preserved.
why_now: The antagonist's fate — contained but unchanged. A different kind of resolution than death.
conflict: Veraine in containment — conscious, intellectually active, already reframing the failure. She tells Ben: 'The emergence you produced was interesting. I will think about it.' Not concession. Not conversion. Intellectual engagement from behind bars.
turning_point: Ben realizes Veraine will never accept she was wrong through argument alone — only through results she can't dismiss. And even then, she'll adapt the theory rather than abandon it. She is the permanent cost of intellectual certainty without empathy.
opening_hook: Veraine in the containment Sera built — clean, functional, inescapable. She sits cross-legged, composed, already writing equations in the dust with one finger.
closing_hook: Ben leaves Veraine's containment. Behind him, she's still writing. The equations might be important. He doesn't look back.
emotional_trajectory: The weight of the antagonist's survival -> the unsatisfying reality of intellectual enemies -> acceptance

stakes.personal: Ben accepting that some enemies cannot be redeemed, only contained
stakes.interpersonal: Veraine's final interaction with Ben — respect without surrender
stakes.external: Veraine alive and thinking is a long-term consideration, not an immediate threat

sensory_details: Veraine's containment — Force-locked, Sera's design; Veraine's composure — unbroken, academic, writing equations; her voice — precise, unruffled, genuinely curious about the emergence; dust motes in the containment light
action_beats: Veraine sits cross-legged in Sera's containment field, composed, writing equations in the dust with one finger
Ben stands outside the containment and listens to Veraine's assessment — precise, unruffled, genuinely curious
Ben turns and walks away from the containment without looking back at the equations still being written
notes: Veraine's arc: lie_unchanged. Defeated but unbroken. The story treats her as wrong for the right reasons. Her survival keeps the philosophical question open.
